projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A complete e-commerce solution with inventory management, payment processing, and analytics dashboard.

caseStudy.problem: Client needed a scalable e-commerce platform to handle 10,000+ daily orders with real-time inventory sync.
caseStudy.solution: Built a microservices architecture with React frontend, Node.js backend, and PostgreSQL database. Implemented Redis caching for product listings.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced page load time by 60%, increased conversion rate by 45%, and achieved 99.9% uptime during peak sales.

projects.title: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Real-time analytics dashboard with interactive charts, user management, and automated reporting.

caseStudy.problem: Company needed a centralized dashboard to visualize data from multiple sources in real-time.
caseStudy.solution: Created a modular dashboard with customizable widgets, real-time data streaming, and role-based access control.
caseStudy.outcome: Enabled data-driven decisions, reduced reporting time by 80%, and improved team productivity.

projects.title: Project Management SaaS
projects.description: Cloud-based project management tool with team collaboration, task tracking, and time management features.

caseStudy.problem: Startup needed a custom project management solution that could scale with their growing team.
caseStudy.solution: Developed a real-time collaborative platform with drag-and-drop kanban boards, time tracking, and integrations.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved 2,000+ active users within 6 months, with a 4.8/5 customer satisfaction rating.

projects.title: Creative Agency Website
projects.description: Stunning portfolio website with smooth animations, CMS integration, and optimized performance.

caseStudy.problem: Creative agency wanted a portfolio that showcases their work with immersive animations and easy content updates.
caseStudy.solution: Built a visually stunning site with GSAP animations, parallax effects, and Sanity CMS for content management.
caseStudy.outcome: Reduced bounce rate by 30%, increased time on site by 60%, and simplified content updates for the team.

projects.title: Appointment Booking System
projects.description: Online booking platform with calendar integration, payment processing, and automated reminders.

caseStudy.problem: Healthcare clinic needed an online booking system to reduce phone calls and no-shows.
caseStudy.solution: Created a user-friendly booking platform with SMS reminders, Google Calendar sync, and online payments.
caseStudy.outcome: Processed 5,000+ monthly bookings, reduced no-shows by 40%, and increased revenue by 25%.

projects.title: Product Launch Landing
projects.description: High-converting landing page with A/B testing capabilities and lead capture optimization.

caseStudy.problem: Tech startup needed a landing page that converts visitors into beta sign-ups for their new product.
caseStudy.solution: Designed a conversion-optimized landing page with compelling copy, social proof, and smooth animations.
caseStudy.outcome: Achieved 12% conversion rate, captured 3,000+ leads, and successfully launched the product.
